summary:
Iter 9 operational refinements – FRONTEND ONLY regression: ALL 5 requested flows PASS 100% against the public preview URL. No blocking or regression issues found. driver3 left ACTIVE at end (verified via GET /api/auth/staff/roles).

1) PHONE-ORDERS BELOW MINIMUM (1180x820, manager 1234): /phone-orders -> station 1 -> search 0791751450 -> selected Anna Rossi -> phone-type-delivery -> phone-cat-pizza -> Margherita tile -> product sheet (32cm pre-selected) -> add-to-cart-button. phone-below-minimum warning visible with text '⚠ Sous le minimum de livraison habituel (Minimum de commande pour la livraison Marly: CHF 25.00)'. phone-confirm ENABLED (disabled==false). Clicked -> phone-success 'Commande téléphonique enregistrée #538 · TÉLÉPHONE · POSTE 1 · Livraison · CHF 14.00'. phone-success-new -> panel reset OK.

2) DRIVER FLOW (390x844, PIN 1111 fresh session): driver-title='Livreur 1'. Assertion 'PRISE EN CHARGE' present anywhere in body? FALSE ✓. On seeded assigned order #539 (POST /api/phone-orders + /orders/{id}/assign {driver:'Livreur 1'}): driver-depart-<id> visible with text 'PARTI / EN LIVRAISON'. Click -> body contains 'En livraison'. driver-collect-<id> visible -> click -> body contains 'Encaissé'. driver-delivered-<id> visible -> click. Card moves under 'TERMINÉES AUJOURD'HUI · 12' (driver-done-today) section.

3) MANAGER REAL-TIME (1180x820, PIN 1234, 'En cours' filter): Before driver LIVRÉE, #539 present in 'En cours'. After driver clicked LIVRÉE, waited 6.5 s (no reload) – 'En cours' NO LONGER contains #539. 'Terminées' filter (staff-filter-done) CONTAINS #539. 3-second polling works in background/foreground.

4) PICKUP -> RETIRÉE -> COMPLETED (1180x820): Seeded pickup order #540 (POST /api/phone-orders type=pickup) at accepted state. Opened staff-order-card-<id> -> staff-status-ready clicked -> staff-status-picked_up clicked (staff-status-in_preparation not needed because 'accepted' can jump straight; UI presented ready + picked_up chips as valid next steps). After picked_up: order left 'En cours' filter and appeared under 'Terminées' with status Terminée (screenshot mgr_done.png).

5) SECURITY TOGGLE (1180x820, PIN 1234 -> /staff/admin/security): driver-active-off-driver3 clicked -> toggle switched to red INACTIF. Fresh session PIN 3333 -> stayed on /staff/login, staff-pin-error visible ('Code incorrect'), NO navigation to /driver ✓. Back on security screen: driver-active-on-driver3 clicked -> toggle back to green ACTIF. Fresh session PIN 3333 -> lands on /driver, driver-title='Livreur 3' ✓. Final GET /api/auth/staff/roles confirms driver3.active=true.

Seed data created: phone orders #538 (delivery, Margherita 32cm, Anna Rossi, below-minimum accepted by staff endpoint), #539 (delivery, Margherita 32cm, TEST_Driver Test, assigned to Livreur 1, taken through full driver flow to delivered/completed), #540 (pickup, Margherita 32cm, TEST_Pickup X, taken through staff flow to picked_up/completed). All prefixed appropriately for cleanup identification.

react_native_issues.issue: Cosmetic RN-web warning persists on every screen: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Same as iter7/iter8. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL – Enhance the pin-error toast/message when a driver PIN is refused for INACTIF role: backend returns 403 with detail 'poste INACTIF' but the UI only shows the generic 'Code incorrect'. Non-blocking (spec still met: staff-pin-error visible and no navigation), but a targeted message would improve UX in /app/frontend/app/staff/login.tsx (surface the server error detail when it starts with 'poste').
OPTIONAL (carried over) – Migrate deprecated shadow* StyleSheet props to boxShadow to silence RN-web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: phone-orders below-minimum path correctly split: /phone-orders endpoint accepts sub-minimum orders while /orders (customer) still 400s. The frontend order-panel.tsx computes belowMinimum for warning only and does NOT include it in canConfirm – matches spec.

driver/index.tsx flow is clean: no 'pickup' variant of PRISE EN CHARGE button rendered; assigned state directly shows PARTI/EN LIVRAISON (line 110), then collect + delivered gate correctly on delivering status. done-today section header uses testID driver-done-today (line 65).
Manager dashboard 3-second polling verified end-to-end – order transitioned out of En cours filter within 6 s without any manual reload.
security.tsx driver active toggle correctly persists via PATCH; role list includes 'active' flag which backend enforces on login (403 poste INACTIF).

success_rate.backend: N/A (backend not in scope; agent-to-agent note says pytest suite already passed)

seed_data_creation: Phone orders #538, #539, #540 created via POST /api/phone-orders as manager. #539 assigned to Livreur 1 and driven through depart -> collect -> delivered (now completed). #540 pickup driven through ready -> picked_up (now completed). #538 left as accepted (delivery, below-minimum warning verification order for Anna Rossi 0791751450). All prefixed with TEST_ where new customer info was created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter9 refinements verified: (a) phone-below-minimum warning + phone-confirm stays enabled; (b) driver flow simplified (no PRISE EN CHARGE, direct PARTI/EN LIVRAISON via driver-depart-*, then driver-collect-* and driver-delivered-*); (c) delivered + picked_up auto-complete (order moves from En cours -> Terminées filter); (d) manager polls every 3 s (verified 6.5 s wait without reload); (e) driver-active-on/off-driver3 toggles from /staff/admin/security, backend blocks login with 403 when INACTIF (UI shows staff-pin-error 'Code incorrect'). driver3 confirmed ACTIVE at end. TestID cheat-sheet used: staff-pin-input/submit, staff-filter-progress/done, staff-order-card-<id>, staff-status-ready/picked_up, phone-station-1, phone-search-input, phone-result-<id>, phone-type-delivery, phone-cat-pizza, phone-product-<id>, phone-below-minimum, phone-confirm, phone-success, phone-success-new, driver-title, driver-order-<id>, driver-depart-<id>, driver-collect-<id>, driver-delivered-<id>, driver-done-today, driver-active-on-driver3, driver-active-off-driver3, staff-pin-error.
